scope: Sampled descendant/process identity monitoring across process groups plus final private-session census; misses unobserved descendants that create another session; no hard memory quota or absolute peak claim. Output and optional owned scratch limits are sampled; no absolute disk quota. Stops at 8MiB output / 128MiB scratch logical bytes / 2GiB observed RSS / 2.5GiB free floor. Output closed after wait.
